rules.reason: the workflow owns the git history: it creates the branch, commits and opens the PR. A commit from the agent makes `git status --porcelain` empty and the workflow concludes nothing changed, silently discarding the fix.
opening the pull request is the workflow's job, with the workflow's token and a draft flag. An agent with gh has an agent with write access to every repository that token reaches.
the harness owns .ronin/. A model that edits settings.local.json edits the rules that constrain it.
